 Lv. 1

 For a brief period when Pan Yinhu's EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike hits an enemy and triggers Quick Assist, the next Agent entering through a Quick Assist or Chain Attack will gain the Meridian Flow effect. This effect provides a Sheer Force boost equal to 9% of Pan Yinhu's ATK and lasts for 25s . The Sheer Force provided by this effect cannot exceed 540 points.

 Base Energy Regen 0
 BASE ATK: 0

 Additional Ability Iron Stomach

 When another character in your squad is a Rupture character or shares the same Faction:
 When Pan Yinhu hits an enemy with Special Attack: Touch of Death, the enemy suffers the Depleted Qi effect, increasing all DMG against the target by 20% . Each hit of Special Attack: Touch of Death inflicts a 10s Depleted Qi effect. This effect can't stack, but repeated hits on the same enemy will extend the duration.

Review
sections.text:
Pan Yinhu is an A-rank Physical Defender Agent whose primary specialties include buffing Sheer Force, healing the party and increasing damage taken by enemies to enhance teammates, particularly Rupture Agents.
 His kit is extremely simple by design, meaning he is easy to pick up for any Proxies wanting to try him out — simple yet effective characterizes this Agent. Only 3 of his abilities are particularly important so we will only detail them: his EX Special, his Special and his Ultimate.
 First of all, let’s discuss Pan Yinhu’s Ultimate: it deals high Physical DMG and at max level, heals the entire squad for up to 1.6% HP/s per second over 8s (for a total of 12.8% HP) on top of an extra 1060 HP. On most Agents, you can expect this healing to equal between 15 to 20% of their HP, which is a good chunk of help towards keeping your squad alive . It can be used whenever your teammates need healing, or if you somehow aren’t taking damage, there is no specific timing to use it. It is worth noting Pan Yinhu’s Mindscape 4 further increases this healing effect by providing additional healing if Agents are hit by an attack (equivalent to 50% of the flat HP healing given by the Ultimate).
 Pan Yinhu’s Special is the more interesting part of his kit and allows him to access his buffing potential. Using EX Special restores 3 points of “Break Force”, a resource he can use to cast Specials called “Touch of Death”. There are a few reasons to execute both of these abilities:
 Using EX Special accesses the Quick Assist of the previous member in the squad, and it activates Pan Yinhu’s “Meridian Flow” effect provided by his Core Passive. Meridian Flow converts a certain percentage of his ATK into Sheer Force for the character who uses this Quick Assist at up to 540 points (Mindscape 0) or 720 points (Mindscape 6). At max Core Passive level, the ATK requirement to maximize the buff (both at Mindscape 0 and Mindscape 6) is 3000 points. This effect lasts 25s.

 Using Touch of Death applies the “Depleted Qi” effect to enemies hit if his Additional Ability is activated, which increases their DMG taken by 20% (with an extra 10% boost at Mindscape 1). This effect lasts 10s.

 Therefore, Pan Yinhu’s simple gameplay sums up to the following steps:
 Use EX Special to buff the Sheer Force of the previous character in the squad by triggering a Quick Assist (ideally a Rupture damage dealer) every 25s;

 Use 1 Touch of Death to increase the DMG taken by enemies every 10s (can be done 3 times with EX Special);

 Use Ultimate if teammates need healing or when readily available.

 This is enough to cover his gameplay — Pan Yinhu doesn’t deal much damage on his own and instead relies on Rupture damage dealers like Yixuan to handle the heavy lifting. He therefore doesn’t want to take up much field time, and his kit is perfect for that.
 Pan Yinhu is nonetheless introduced as a pretty good contender in the meta to buff Rupture agents. As the only direct buffer of Sheer Force on his release, he fills a unique role with Rupture damage dealers like Yixuan to increase their damage by a lot — as general ATK increasing supports are less favourable to buff the Sheer Force of Rupture agents than Pan Yinhu’s buff. This makes him fill a niche, but appreciated role, not to mention the healing provided by his Ultimate gives extra comfort in battle, allowing you to tank a few enemy hits without budging.
 In conclusion, Pan Yinhu is an easy, plug-and-play Support for Rupture Agents, able to buff their Sheer Force DMG effectively while keeping a simplistic playstyle and a good balance between buffing capabilities and survivability via the healing his Ultimate provides. Overall a potent Support Agent which does exactly what you expect him to in an effective way.

sections.heading: Best W-Engines
sections.text:
The W-Engines are listed in order of priority . Sometimes the percentages appearing near them won't reflect their performance as pure damage or Stun output isn't the only thing we're looking at - the utility of the W-Engine might be more important than the calculations imply.

 1

 Tusks of Fury (S 1 )

 The best option for Defender Supports if available. Provides 18% DMG and 12% Daze to all party members for 20s whenever a Perfect Dodge or Interrupt is triggered which is possible to upkeep permanently. Also gives 30% Shield value increase if applicable (not the case for Pan Yinhu) and a high Base ATK along with extra Impact for higher Daze potential.
 Usage: 4.56 %
 Shiyu Defense: 29829
 Deadly Assault: 29391

 2

 Tremor Trigram Vessel (S 5 )

 Pan Yinhu's signature W-Engine is the best A-rank option available for him, providing both high amounts of ATK and Energy Regen which are the stats he needs. The extra EX Special and Ultimate DMG provided to the user also constitute a small increase to total team damage which is always good to take.
 Usage: 85.51 %
 Shiyu Defense: 27698
 Deadly Assault: 25850

 3

 Spring Embrace (S 5 )

 Grants the same amount of ATK as Tremor Trigram Vessel which is useful but its additional effect doesn't provide any extra DMG. Has a small effect which reduces DMG taken and also gives extra Energy regeneration if damage is taken by the user, but overall this effect is negligible. Nonetheless, it's better than nothing.
 Usage: 0.59 %
 Shiyu Defense: 26244
 Deadly Assault: 25544

 4

 Peacekeeper - Specialized (S 5 )

 On Pan Yinhu, this W-Engine's additional effect is mostly useless, however it gives the same amount of ATK as Tremor Trigram Vessel which is useful. If shielded, Pan Yinhu will gain extra Energy Regen but this is mostly negligible. Similarly, the extra Anomaly Buildup on EX Specials and Assist Follow-Ups can be ignored for the most part, however the two effects are better than nothing.
 Usage: 3.56 %
 Shiyu Defense: 28308
 Deadly Assault: 24575

sections.heading: Synergy
sections.text:
Below we list only the most important synergies for Pan Yinhu . The character can work with others if you know what to do and how to use them.

 Yixuan Manato Yidhari Banyue - Pan is the only non-limited unit who is dedicated to assisting Rupture Agents. Although he is not an ideal option, he is still likely to be superior to most other Supports, and even has some minor synergy with existing Rupture Agents, such as with the healing on his Ultimate. Despite being an A-Rank, his buffs are comparable to that of other Limited Supports (like Astra), and if at M6, he is second place only to Lucia in terms of his buff contribution to Rupture teams.
 Lucia - Although Pan Yinhu does not directly benefit from most of Lucia’s buffs, as both are dedicated supporting units for Rupture Agents, running them both together can work well. It isn’t ideal, given that both provide flat Sheer Force buffs (so they dilute each others’ contribution) and neither has particularly good Daze build-up, but overall the raw amount of buffs they provide more than makes up for it.

 Ratings
 This tier list assesses Agents (characters) based on their combat potential in Zenless Zone Zero's most demanding contents - Deadly Assault (DA) and Shiyu Defense (SD) . Please keep in mind Zenless Zone Zero is a skill-based game and each character has a different playstyle, difficulty level and even special tricks and combos. Zenless Zone Zero is also a team based game and it's only by combining both these factors to the highest level a character can reach optimal performance.

 Pros & Cons
 Pros
 Extremely simple plug-and-play Support Agent — anyone can pick him up. Basically the equivalent of Lucy for Sheer Force-scaling Agents, with very low field time and effective buffs;

 The only Sheer Force buffer at the time of his release, a unique and valuable role;

 Rare presence of healing in his kit which helps with party survivability;

 Very low-cost Agent who needs little resources investment-wise aside from his ATK requirement;

 Scales well with Mindscapes while retaining his functionality at a baseline.

 Cons
 Only usable with Rupture Agents — very specialized character (excels in his niche but doesn't have the generalist potential of Agents like Nicole/Lucy);

 Must be placed before the DPS Agent in the party which can make some team options awkward (with characters like Trigger);

 Has a scarce amount of effective W-Engine options.

 Review
 Pan Yinhu is an A-rank Physical Defender Agent whose primary specialties include buffing Sheer Force, healing the party and increasing damage taken by enemies to enhance teammates, particularly Rupture Agents.
 His kit is extremely simple by design, meaning he is easy to pick up for any Proxies wanting to try him out — simple yet effective characterizes this Agent. Only 3 of his abilities are particularly important so we will only detail them: his EX Special, his Special and his Ultimate.
 First of all, let’s discuss Pan Yinhu’s Ultimate: it deals high Physical DMG and at max level, heals the entire squad for up to 1.6% HP/s per second over 8s (for a total of 12.8% HP) on top of an extra 1060 HP. On most Agents, you can expect this healing to equal between 15 to 20% of their HP, which is a good chunk of help towards keeping your squad alive . It can be used whenever your teammates need healing, or if you somehow aren’t taking damage, there is no specific timing to use it. It is worth noting Pan Yinhu’s Mindscape 4 further increases this healing effect by providing additional healing if Agents are hit by an attack (equivalent to 50% of the flat HP healing given by the Ultimate).
 Pan Yinhu’s Special is the more interesting part of his kit and allows him to access his buffing potential. Using EX Special restores 3 points of “Break Force”, a resource he can use to cast Specials called “Touch of Death”. There are a few reasons to execute both of these abilities:
 Using EX Special accesses the Quick Assist of the previous member in the squad, and it activates Pan Yinhu’s “Meridian Flow” effect provided by his Core Passive. Meridian Flow converts a certain percentage of his ATK into Sheer Force for the character who uses this Quick Assist at up to 540 points (Mindscape 0) or 720 points (Mindscape 6). At max Core Passive level, the ATK requirement to maximize the buff (both at Mindscape 0 and Mindscape 6) is 3000 points. This effect lasts 25s.

 Using Touch of Death applies the “Depleted Qi” effect to enemies hit if his Additional Ability is activated, which increases their DMG taken by 20% (with an extra 10% boost at Mindscape 1). This effect lasts 10s.

 Therefore, Pan Yinhu’s simple gameplay sums up to the following steps:
 Use EX Special to buff the Sheer Force of the previous character in the squad by triggering a Quick Assist (ideally a Rupture damage dealer) every 25s;

 Use 1 Touch of Death to increase the DMG taken by enemies every 10s (can be done 3 times with EX Special);

 Use Ultimate if teammates need healing or when readily available.

 This is enough to cover his gameplay — Pan Yinhu doesn’t deal much damage on his own and instead relies on Rupture damage dealers like Yixuan to handle the heavy lifting. He therefore doesn’t want to take up much field time, and his kit is perfect for that.
 Pan Yinhu is nonetheless introduced as a pretty good contender in the meta to buff Rupture agents. As the only direct buffer of Sheer Force on his release, he fills a unique role with Rupture damage dealers like Yixuan to increase their damage by a lot — as general ATK increasing supports are less favourable to buff the Sheer Force of Rupture agents than Pan Yinhu’s buff. This makes him fill a niche, but appreciated role, not to mention the healing provided by his Ultimate gives extra comfort in battle, allowing you to tank a few enemy hits without budging.
 In conclusion, Pan Yinhu is an easy, plug-and-play Support for Rupture Agents, able to buff their Sheer Force DMG effectively while keeping a simplistic playstyle and a good balance between buffing capabilities and survivability via the healing his Ultimate provides. Overall a potent Support Agent which does exactly what you expect him to in an effective way.

 How to play
 Rotations
 Pan Yinhu's rotations are extremely simple in design. He only wants to activate a few of his key abilities when available at specific intervals. His gameplay can be summed up to the following steps:
 Use EX Special to buff the Sheer Force of the previous character in the squad by triggering a Quick Assist (ideally a Rupture damage dealer) every 25s;

 Use 1 Touch of Death to increase the DMG taken by enemies every 10s (can be done 3 times with EX Special);

 Use Ultimate if teammates need healing or when readily available.

 With Yixuan as his DPS to support, ensure you execute Defensive Assists to switch into Pan Yinhu to feed Adrenaline to Yixuan and generate extra Daze.Additional Note: Make sure Pan Yinhu is always the party member following the DPS he is supporting, so that he can Quick Assist into them with his EX Special and provide his Sheer Force boost properly.

 Teams & Synergy

 Synergy
 Below we list only the most important synergies for Pan Yinhu . The character can work with others if you know what to do and how to use them.

 Yixuan Manato Yidhari Banyue - Pan is the only non-limited unit who is dedicated to assisting Rupture Agents. Although he is not an ideal option, he is still likely to be superior to most other Supports, and even has some minor synergy with existing Rupture Agents, such as with the healing on his Ultimate. Despite being an A-Rank, his buffs are comparable to that of other Limited Supports (like Astra), and if at M6, he is second place only to Lucia in terms of his buff contribution to Rupture teams.
 Lucia - Although Pan Yinhu does not directly benefit from most of Lucia’s buffs, as both are dedicated supporting units for Rupture Agents, running them both together can work well. It isn’t ideal, given that both provide flat Sheer Force buffs (so they dilute each others’ contribution) and neither has particularly good Daze build-up, but overall the raw amount of buffs they provide more than makes up for it.
